words.en: don't count your chickens before they hatch
words.ex: Our team is two goals ahead, but don't count your chickens before they hatch: there are still twenty minutes left.

words.ex: Apply to several universities, not just one; don't put all your eggs in one basket.

words.ex: The café looks old and plain from outside, but never judge a book by its cover: the food is excellent.

words.en: never look a gift horse in the mouth
words.ex: The prize phone from the quiz was an older model, but you shouldn't look a gift horse in the mouth.

words.en: take care of the pennies and the pounds will take care of themselves
words.uz: mayda pulni asrasang, katta pul yig‘iladi
words.ex: Stop buying a coffee every morning! Remember: if you take care of the pennies, the pounds will take care of themselves.

words.en: we'll cross that bridge when we come to it
words.uz: muammoni u yuzaga kelganda hal qilamiz
words.ex: "What if the flight is cancelled?" "Let's not worry yet; we'll cross that bridge when we come to it."

words.en: when the cat's away, the mice will play
words.ex: As soon as the coach went to answer a phone call, the players stopped training and sat on the grass; when the cat's away, the mice will play.

words.en: you can lead a horse to water but you can't make it drink
words.ex: I gave my friend Sherzod three good books about saving money, but he hasn't opened them. You can lead a horse to water, but you can't make it drink.

words.en: one swallow doesn't make a summer
words.ex: Our new shop had one busy week, but one swallow doesn't make a summer.
words.gap: one swallow doesn't make a summer

words.ex: Everyone says the sports centre is closing; I'm not sure it's true, but there's no smoke without fire.

words.en: people who live in glass houses shouldn't throw stones
words.uz: o‘zing aybdor bo‘lsang, boshqani tanqid qilma
words.ex: Elyor complained that I'm always late, but he's late every day himself; people who live in glass houses shouldn't throw stones.

words.en: too many cooks spoil the broth
words.uz: oshpaz ko‘p bo‘lsa, osh sho‘r bo‘lar
words.ex: Ten of us tried to plan the class trip together and nothing got decided; too many cooks spoil the broth.
words.gap: too many cooks spoil the broth

words.uz: ko‘pchilik bo‘lib qilingan ish tez bitadi
words.ex: With the whole mahalla helping at the hashar, we cleaned the park in an hour; many hands make light work.
